parsed.explanation: The objection is locally right that the cut count in the overlay lemma is deferred ("details omitted"). But the construction itself is fully specified — concatenate A, lay the concatenated B-row over the initial length-q segment, cut both rows at the union of division points, pair corresponding cells — and the write-up states the counting method. The count it asserts is exactly what that construction yields: at most |B|-1 images of B's interior boundaries plus the endpoint q in the A-row, and at most |A|-1 images of A's boundaries in the B-row, totalling |A|+|B|-1, with coincidences only reducing it. So bound (5), and hence the budget (13) underpinning L3.2, stands; only a routine verification is compressed.
